# Environment variables

This is a usage inventory, not a promise that every variable is public configuration.

| Variable | Read by |
| --- | --- |
| `CODEX_HOME` | `src/node/bridge/agents/codex.js` |
| `HOME` | `src/node/bridge/agents/codex.js`, `src/node/bridge/agents/ego-browser.js`, `src/node/bridge/token.js` |
| `PATH` | `src/node/bridge/agents/isolation.js` |
| `RABBITHOLE_BRIDGE_CODEX_BIN` | `src/node/bridge/agents/codex.js` |
| `RABBITHOLE_BRIDGE_EGO_BIN` | `src/node/bridge/agents/ego-browser.js` |
| `RABBITHOLE_BRIDGE_EGO_SKILL` | `src/node/bridge/agents/ego-browser.js` |
| `RABBITHOLE_DEV` | `src/node/shared/source-reader.js` |
| `RABBITHOLE_DIR` | `src/node/bridge/token.js` |
| `RABBITHOLE_NO_BROWSER` | `src/node/shared/process.js` |
| `RABBITHOLE_PROXY_URL` | `build.mjs` |
